summary: Class size over shop stations: Metalworking & Welding I, Ridgeway Regional
description: Filed 11/16/2026 by R. Clayton, building steward, Ridgeway Regional. Metalworking & Welding I, period 2, carries 26 students for 8 welding bays, past the two-to-a-bay limit in the shop safety plan. Remedy sought: split the section or cap it at the bay limit.
